- When sentiment is 1.0 in the recent history (e.g., day 11-18), model tends to overestimate prices; reduce forecast by 1-2% for the next 3-5 days.
- Model consistently overestimates early in the 30-day horizon, especially after a recent spike; apply a 2-5% downward correction for days 1-7.
- After a sharp price spike (e.g., >5% from prior day), model often overshoots in the following 3-5 days; cap forecast at +3% above prior peak.
- Mean reversion is strong in the final 5-7 days of the 30-day horizon; reduce forecast by 1-3% for days 25-30 if prior 5 days show downward trend.
- If sentiment remains 0.0 for 5+ consecutive days, model tends to underestimate; add 0.5-1.5% to forecast for days 1-3.
- Model underestimates when true price drops below 70.00; if forecast is below 70, add 1-2% to correct for lagged reaction.
